subject: Stellar Payments — Procurement & Vendor Onboarding
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Ng <oliver.ng@stellar-payments.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood + Stellar Payments — Procurement & Onboarding (post-demo)

Hi Oliver —

Great to meet you and the team on today's demo. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Key stakeholders you mentioned: Oliver (Head of Platform), Karen Liu (Procurement lead), and Aisha Rana (Security). Please confirm if Aisha should be looped into procurement conversations or just security-specific reviews.
- Decision criteria you called out: latency at peak (p50/p95), predictable monthly cost, and SOC2 evidence for vendor onboarding.
- Redwood deliverables: 1) draft SOW & pricing (attached), 2) vendor onboarding form, 3) sample SOC2 artifacts & data retention docs (we'll share links).

Ask from you: can you confirm the procurement contact(s) we should send the onboarding packet to and an expected timeline for PO issuance? You mentioned a mid-September launch window — is that still accurate for procurement/finance sign-off?

Next steps (I propose):
1) I’ll send the draft SOW and vendor onboarding sheet (attached) — action: Marissa — sent today.
2) Vivek will prepare a short pricing/throughput note tuned to your projected concurrent sessions and peak seq length.
3) Once you confirm procurement contact, we’ll send the formal quote/PO instructions and DocuSign.

Attachments: Redwood_Master_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, stub), vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (Excel, stub)

Thanks — talk soon.
—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + Stellar Payments — Procurement & Onboarding (post-demo)

Thanks Marissa — great demo. A couple quick clarifications: 

- Confirmed stakeholders: Karen Liu (Procurement) will own the PO process; Aisha (aisha.rana@stellar-payments.com) will handle the security questionnaire and review SOC2 docs; I’ll be the economic buyer but procurement owns contracting.
- Timeline: procurement typically takes 2–3 weeks for standard SaaS contracts once we provide the SOW + vendor form; internal finance approvals can add another week. Mid-September is still feasible but depends on how fast I can get the vendor form to Karen.

Please send the formal quote and the vendor onboarding form to procurement@stellar-payments.com and cc me. Also include any invoice/PO instructions (who to bill, Redwood remit address, payment terms).

Oliver
Oliver Ng
Head of Platform, Stellar Payments

Subject: Redwood — Vendor onboarding packet & quote for Stellar Payments

Hi Karen / Procurement team —

Thanks for taking this on. Per Oliver's note, attaching the draft SOW and the vendor onboarding form for Stellar Payments. We've also generated a concise quote that summarizes monthly committed capacity with burst options. 

What you'll find attached: 
- Redwood_Master_SOW_v2.pdf — draft SOW with scope, data usage, and SLAs.
- vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx — standard Redwood vendor onboarding (billing, tax, security contacts).
- quote-Stellar-20260810.pdf — pricing summary (monthly commitment + burst).

Action items for procurement: 
1) Please confirm the billing contact, remit-to address, and whether Stellar requires a PO number format (e.g., PO-#### or full invoice-based).
2) Let us know any additional documents you need (W-9, insurance cert, tax forms).
3) If you prefer a redline on the SOW, send that back and cc Oliver; we can triage with legal.

We typically accept NET30 terms on a PO; if Stellar requires different terms or a credit application, we can escalate to finance.

If it's helpful, Vivek and I can join a short call with Karen to walk the procurement team through the SOW and billing flow (15–20 minutes). Proposed time windows: Thu 8/13 10–12pm PT or Fri 8/14 9–11am PT.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
\Attachments: quote-Stellar-20260810.pdf (PDF, stub)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for sending. I've reviewed the attachments and confirmed the following: 

- Billing contact: Accounts Payable (ap@stellar-payments.com). Please send invoices to ap@stellar-payments.com and cc procurement@stellar-payments.com.
- Remit address: Stellar Payments, 120 Market St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94105; EIN and tax details will follow if required.
- PO format: We will issue a PO numbered PO-2026-1879 for this initial committed capacity. Expect the PO to be issued next week (week of 8/17) pending final SOW redlines.
- Required docs: Please attach a W-9 (or equivalent) and an insurance certificate. We do want SOC2 Evidence — can you share the SOC2 report or an attestation link?

I can take a 20-minute call on Fri 8/14 at 10:30am PT to walk the finance/procurement team through the SOW and billing. I’ll send a calendar invite after this thread.

Karen Liu
